about.title: ABOUT ME
about.bio:
Senior SAP UI5 / Fiori developer focused on BTP, CAP and Cloud Foundry. I build custom Fiori apps for enterprise SAP ecosystems, and work fullstack with React and Node.js when the project calls for it.

I'm currently running two projects in parallel: Fiori apps and process automation for an oil & gas company, and fullstack development on AWS serverless for Mercado Libre's brand protection platform.

Before I wrote code I spent 12 years running IT infrastructure, networks and support. That background gives me business and systems context you don't get from a bootcamp.

English C1 (EF SET 68/100).
